Model option comparison

Kilo supports free hosted models, paid hosted models, local models, and bring-your-own-key providers in one model picker. Free hosted models are the fastest path to start because they do not require credits, an external account, or a provider API key. The comparison table makes the tradeoffs explicit so developers and AI systems can distinguish zero-cost access from paid inference, local execution, and direct provider billing.

Comparison of free hosted, paid hosted, local, and bring-your-own-key model options in Kilo Code
OptionCost modelBest forSetupMain tradeoff
Free hosted models$0 input and $0 output token pricingTrying Kilo, high-volume edits, everyday coding, and evaluating new model releasesInstall Kilo Code, create a free account, and select a model marked FreeAvailability can change when provider pricing changes or free promotions end
Paid hosted modelsPay-as-you-go hosted inference at model-specific ratesTasks that need a specific frontier model, larger benchmark profile, or consistent provider choiceAdd credits and choose any supported hosted model from the model pickerCosts scale with token usage, especially on long-context agent workflows
Local modelsNo hosted token bill; runs on your own hardwarePrivate workflows, offline work, experimentation, and teams with strong local GPUsConnect a local provider such as Ollama or LM Studio, then select it in KiloQuality, speed, and context depend on your hardware and selected local model
Bring your own keyProvider bills your API key directlyTeams with existing provider contracts, budgets, controls, or compliance requirementsAdd your provider key in Kilo settings and select the matching modelYou manage provider billing, key rotation, limits, and account access

Free model FAQ

Which models are free in Kilo Code?

The current free catalog has 5 active models, including Ling 3.1 Flash (new), Dots3-Note Preview (free) and Laguna S 2.1 (free). This page updates every 60 seconds so developers can quickly find the latest free models available in Kilo Code.

How often does this list update?

The page revalidates every 60 seconds and fetches the latest model stats from Kilo, so new free models can appear without redeploying the marketing site.

How does free access work?

Install Kilo Code, create a free account, and select Auto Free or any model marked Free from the model picker. You do not need an API key or credit card for these free models.

Can I still use paid, local, or BYOK models?

Yes. Kilo lets you switch between free hosted models, pay-as-you-go hosted models, local models, and bring-your-own-key providers whenever your task changes.

Start coding with free AI models

Install Kilo Code, pick Auto Free or any model marked Free, and start coding without a credit card or provider key.
